# `assets/AssetCache.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/AssetCache.js`

engine/assets/AssetCache.js — local engine cache (spec §3, cache://).  Converted artifacts (engine binaries, preview meshes, thumbnails, colliders, SDFs, material packs) are cached under cache:// keyed by content hash so a re-import of the same source is instant. The primary backend is the Origin Private File System (OPFS) — origin-private and optimized for file access; an in-memory Map backs environments without OPFS (Node tests, locked-down contexts) so the rest of the runtime is backend-agnostic.
